The subject is crate labels
Crate Labels and Pet Travel Notice

Travelers need to check every crate label before arrival at the Companion Animal Travel Desk so the pet lounge, the transfer area, and the boarding flow stay smooth.

Please use clear, easy-to-read labels and keep them matched to the right carrier. Calm handling matters here, and the team will keep working that way so animals are treated kindly and travelers are not left guessing. <<FACT F001>> If you are moving with Marley or another companion animal, make sure the details on the crate stay easy to spot from the outside.

Before you head to the pet relief area, take a quick look at the route and the posted access notes. <<FACT F018>> That small step helps prevent delays and keeps everyone moving without fuss. Aurelia Skyways wants companion travel to stay steady, humane, and simple, and good labeling is part of that.

If anything looks faded, missing, or mismatched, bring it to the Companion Animal Travel Desk right away so the team can help.
